articles.summary: UHS President and CEO Marc D. Miller discusses UHS’ acquisition of Talkspace and the opportunity to reshape behavioral healthcare by bringing virtual and in-person care together across a full continuum of services.
articles.title: LEADERS Magazine: A More Connected Model of Care – An Interview with Marc D. Miller

articles.summary: The acquisition and the opportunities ahead have generated significant media interest, with coverage examining how UHS and Talkspace can help reshape the way behavioral healthcare is accessed, navigated and delivered.
articles.title: Media Coverage Highlights: UHS and Talkspace Bring Together Virtual, Outpatient and Inpatient Care to Advance a Connected Behavioral Healthcare Continuum
